title: 2D Animation
summary: Explainers, educational animation and character work that turn dense information into something people actually follow.
description:
Two-dimensional animation is the most direct way to make an abstract subject concrete. We design the visual language, script the narrative and animate it frame by frame so the idea survives contact with the audience.

Our 2D pipeline runs from thumbnail and storyboard through to a finished master with sound design — always with the option of an animatic review before production commits.

faqs.question: How long is a typical 2D explainer?
faqs.answer: Most explainers land between 60 and 120 seconds. We will recommend a runtime once we understand the message, the audience and where the video will be watched.

faqs.question: Can you match an existing illustration style?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your brand system or existing artwork and we will build a style frame for approval before production begins.

faqs.question: Do you handle voice-over and music?
faqs.answer: We direct casting, record or source voice-over and license music and sound design as part of the production scope.

title: 3D Animation & Visual Production
summary: Product, industrial and architectural animation — modelled, textured and lit to show exactly how something works.
description:
When a subject cannot be filmed — too small, too large, too dangerous or simply not built yet — 3D makes it visible. We model from your CAD, photographs or sketches and build a scene that reads instantly.

From wireframe to final render, every stage is reviewable. You get an exploded, cutaway or exploded-sequence view of your own product or facility, with the lighting and materials to make it credible.
deliverables: Source scene files and asset manifests

faqs.question: Can you work from CAD files?
faqs.answer: Yes. STEP, IGES, SolidWorks, Revit and mesh formats are all workable inputs. We will tell you early if a model needs retopology first.

faqs.question: How realistic can the render be?
faqs.answer: As realistic as the brief requires. We agree on a look-development target early so realism never becomes an open-ended moving goal.

faqs.question: Do we receive the 3D files?
faqs.answer: Yes — source scene files and asset manifests are part of final delivery, with naming conventions documented.

title: Motion Graphics
summary: Typography, data and brand motion graphics designed as a reusable system rather than a one-off.
description:
Motion graphics carry the parts of your message that words alone cannot: hierarchy, sequence and emphasis. We design the system so the second video is as fast to produce as the first.

Everything is built to be re-skinned and re-cut — templates, presets and a documented style guide come with the delivery.
deliverables: Designed motion system and style frames

faqs.question: Can your templates be used by our team?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build editable templates with clear controls and a short handover session so your team can produce variations confidently.

faqs.question: Do you animate data live from a spreadsheet?
faqs.answer: For recurring reports we can connect charts to structured data so the graphics update with your numbers rather than being redrawn.

faqs.question: How many revisions are included?
faqs.answer: Scope is agreed in the proposal — typically two structured review rounds per stage, with additional rounds quoted transparently.

title: Digital Visual Assets & AI-Assisted Production
summary: 3D asset libraries, real-time assets and AI-assisted production that speed up delivery without lowering the bar.
description:
Studios and product teams do not just need a video — they need the assets behind it. We build libraries that stay consistent, documented and ready for the next project.

AI-assisted production is a lever, not a shortcut. We use it for ideation, variation and clean-up under human art direction, and we are explicit about how and where it is used.

faqs.question: How is AI used in your production?
faqs.answer: For exploration, variation and time-consuming clean-up tasks. Final creative direction, composition and brand accuracy stay with our artists, and we disclose AI use on every project.

faqs.question: Do you sign over the assets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Delivery terms and licensing are set out in the proposal, including whether assets are exclusive to your organisation.

faqs.question: Can assets be delivered for an existing engine?
faqs.answer: We export to your target engine and verify material and scale conventions before handover.
